##: Unofficial portable build of Astra Gate, packaged by BobH-Official/Astra-Gate-Portable from upstream release tags.
description: Local AI gateway that relays requests between AI clients and providers, with protocol conversion, usage billing and privacy guardrails
notes: Unofficial portable build. Product bugs belong upstream (https://github.com/239573049/Astra-Gate); packaging bugs belong to https://github.com/BobH-Official/Astra-Gate-Portable.
Data lives in '$dir\data' because ASTRA_HOME is set to that directory and the directory is persisted.
Without ASTRA_HOME the app would use '%USERPROFILE%\.astra'; existing data there is not migrated.
The bundled server runs as a child process of the app; nothing is installed as a service.
Autostart writes HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run entries only when enabled in the app or with 'astra autostart enable'.

The astra:// protocol is not registered automatically. The optional helpers scoop-register-protocol.ps1 and scoop-unregister-protocol.ps1 are downloaded into '$dir' but never run by Scoop; run scoop-register-protocol.ps1 with -AppDir '$dir' and -ExecutionPolicy Bypass to register join links, and scoop-unregister-protocol.ps1 the same way to remove them.
Uninstalling removes the astra:// registration only when it points at this installation; a registration that points somewhere else is left untouched.
Binaries are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch.
post_install: warn ('Optional astra:// helper scripts were not downloaded: ' + $_.Exception.Message)

script: Write-Host ('Removed the astra:// registration pointing at ' + $exe)
